items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I put Russ Papaya in business and gave him music.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. But if I played for a convention or anything, I could almost exactly the number of men, you know, I could play for a Buick, I could get 15, and I'd use Al Hurt on first trumpet. But I couldn't use Hurt because he overpowered the band. I couldn't use him on carnival ball. It would sound like a trumpet solo. You know? He was a hard worker. He didn't have all this beard and everything like that. I used to call him, I used to call him, oh, I had a nickname. I said, about, he'd have been until he was fat.…
And Elri Mazur died, I just heard that last night. Elri Mazur? I just heard that last night.
